what: a stone hoe: a long plain wooden handle; across its top end one flat chipped warm grey-tan stone, bound on with cream cord, blade shaped like a garden hoe, about 10 px wide and 4-5 px tall, flat and plain, set at a right angle to the handle so the blade points down-left; the blade clearly bigger than the handle is thick, but no block-shaped hammer head, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
